editorial.name: Flowbite
editorial.descriptionZh: Flowbite 是建在 Tailwind CSS 之上的开源组件库，600+ 组件与区块之外还出 Figma 设计文件、图标、插画和 Pro 版。
editorial.takeawayZh: 复制 Tailwind 组件或区块代码直接用
editorial.noteZh: 顶栏先一条公告 We have launched the new Flowbite Dashboard featuring over 60+ pages，导航是 Docs、Blocks、Figma、Icons、Illustrations、Blog、Pro version、Pricing & FAQ 加一个 Sign in。首屏大标题 Build websites even faster with components on top of Tailwind CSS，两个按钮 Get started 与 Explore components，紧跟着嵌了一段 YouTube 的 Flowbite Crash Course 视频。正文的 Flowbite in other technologies 一节把 React、Vue、Svelte、Angular、MCP Apps、TypeScript、Next.js 等适配逐个列出，组件清单从 Alerts、Accordion、Avatar 一路排到 QR Code 与 WYSIWYG Editor。
editorial.pricing: Freemium; Pro version and paid plans under Pricing & FAQ

reasons.statement: 首页 description 写 open-source library of over 600+ UI components, sections, and pages built with the utility classes from Tailwind CSS，用户最直接拿走的是可复制的组件代码。
导航里 Docs / Blocks / Figma / Icons / Illustrations 并列，组件之外还有区块、图标与插画，归通用界面组件库比归单一素材类更贴。
